with: • Migration strategy (decided): Grant “View All Applications” permission to all existing enquiry users at go-live. This prevents a visibility regression for back-office and operations teams who currently see all applications. As new applications flow in with Staff ID attribution, administrators progressively restrict this permission — removing it from staff-level users once their incoming cases are tagged. (a) Non-Sale departments: no change. (b) Existing users with Department = Sale: Staff ID must be assigned via Edit User (Maker/Checker) at go-live; until then the user sees no applications (IM005). (c) One-off backfill: historical applications whose stored [Referral code] (AMP-464 / AMP-1454) matches an active Staff ID canonical key are tagged to that Staff ID (source = Backfill, audited). Other historical cases remain visible to non-Sale users only. No round-robin backfill.
